description: Update a machine's Anima checkout to origin/main safely (report, fast-forward, install, redeploy watchdog, restart, health-check, roll back), and compare anima.json between machines.

update.description: Run ON the machine being updated. Fetches, reports incoming commits (migrations, watchdog, deps, config shape), fast-forwards main, bun install / watchdog:deploy when needed, restarts the watchdog, waits for health, rolls back on failure. Also fast-forwards the skills repo.

args.name: --check
args.description: Report only: what would change, without touching anything

config-keys.description: Print this machine's anima.json key paths (values elided except booleans and model/runtime/profile/mode).

config-diff.description: Compare this machine's anima.json key paths with another machine's over ssh. No secret values are printed.

args.name: ssh-host
args.description: ssh host of the other machine, e.g. anima-sedes
